entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Oh, hello. I... I think I need to make a return? I'm just so overwhelmed by the website, I couldn't figure it out.
I can definitely help you with that. To get started, could I please get your name and order number?
Yes, it's Sarah Jenkins, order number 78-221-904. It's about a pair of cycling shoes I bought.
Thank you, Sarah. I have your order right here. To make sure I understand correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

I... I'm not sure what the difference is. They just hurt my feet. I think it's something to do with the spot where the cleats attach. They gave me awful blisters after just one ride. The return policy was so confusing. Can't you just help me?
I'm very sorry to hear the shoes are causing blisters; that sounds uncomfortable. Let me just check the purchase date for you. I see here you received them 75 days ago.
Is that bad? I told you I didn't understand the policy. I was so confused.
Not at all, you're perfectly fine. For standard items like these cycling shoes, our policy allows for returns within 90 days. Since you're at day 75, I can absolutely approve a full refund for you.
Oh! Really? That's such a relief. So I can get a refund? That's wonderful, thank you so much!

You're very welcome, Sarah. I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email we have on file. Just place the shoes in a box, attach the label, and you can drop them off. Your refund will be processed as soon as we receive them. Can I assist you with anything else today?
No, that's everything. You've been a huge help. Thank you again, Charlie.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day!
